adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a new security-relevant hostname validation in `app/models/embeddable_host.rb` via `validates_format_of :host, :with => /\A[a-z0-9]+([\-\.]{1}[a-z0-9]+)*\.[a-z]{2,5}(:[0-9]{1,5})?(\/.*)?\Z/i`. The added specs in `spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb` only cover positive cases (trimming scheme/path and allowing known hosts) and do not include negative tests for boundary/denial cases implied by the regex (e.g., TLD > 5, invalid hyphen/dot adjacency patterns, or IP-literal hosts). This is a concrete missing-test gap for new nontrivial validation logic, but not a verifiable functional defect by itself.
